faqs.answer: It means designing software around your specific business workflows, users, rules and integrations instead of adapting your organisation to a fixed generic product.

faqs.question: Should we replace our existing software?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. We first evaluate whether the better approach is replacement, integration, extension or selective modernisation.

faqs.question: Can the application be implemented in phases?
faqs.answer: Yes. Large programmes can be divided into logical modules or business functions and introduced progressively.

faqs.question: Will the application integrate with our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Where suitable integration options exist, yes. Integration requirements are assessed during discovery and architecture planning.

faqs.question: Can Metaphi maintain the application after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ongoing application support, enhancement and managed services can be provided after implementation.

customSolutions.title: Enterprise AI
customSolutions.heroHeadline: Turn AI Into Working Business Capability
customSolutions.summary: Metaphi helps organisations identify where AI can create practical business value, then designs and integrates AI solutions into real workflows, systems and decision processes.
customSolutions.problemText: The challenge for most businesses is no longer understanding that AI exists. It is deciding where AI actually creates value, which workflows should change, which data can be used, where human oversight is required, how AI connects with existing systems, and how quality, privacy and security should be managed. Metaphi approaches AI from the operating problem outward—not from the model inward.

customSolutions.techApproachText: The level of governance should reflect the risk of the use case.
customSolutions.secondaryNarrativeText: AI often creates more value when embedded inside an existing workflow. For example, instead of creating a separate chatbot, an operations manager receives AI-assisted exception summaries directly inside the operations platform. Instead of another AI tool, a sales application automatically prepares account summaries before meetings. This is why Metaphi combines AI capability with software engineering and integration expertise.

faqs.question: Where should a business start with AI?
faqs.answer: Start by identifying high-friction workflows, repetitive knowledge tasks, document-heavy processes or decisions where better information could improve outcomes.

faqs.question: Does every AI project require a custom model?
faqs.answer: No. Many business applications can use existing foundation models or specialised services combined with business data, integration and workflow design.

faqs.question: Can AI connect with existing enterprise applications?
faqs.answer: Yes, where suitable integrations and system access exist.

faqs.question: Do you build AI agents?
faqs.answer: We can design agentic workflows where the use case genuinely benefits from multi-step AI actions, tool usage and appropriate controls.

faqs.question: How do you manage AI accuracy?
faqs.answer: The approach depends on the use case and may include grounding, validation, structured outputs, evaluations, human review and monitoring.

saasProducts.title: Stockiphi
saasProducts.heroHeadline: Simplify Inventory and Everyday Operations With Stockiphi
saasProducts.summary: Bring greater structure and visibility to inventory-related operations through a focused SaaS platform designed for everyday business use.
saasProducts.problemText: Inventory often becomes difficult to manage long before a business believes it needs a large enterprise system. Stock information may live across spreadsheets, handwritten records or multiple applications. Teams spend time verifying availability, reconciling movements and coordinating basic operational information. Stockiphi is intended to make this everyday inventory management simpler.
saasProducts.secondaryNarrativeText: Stockiphi is a standardised Metaphi SaaS product, not a bespoke implementation. Businesses adopt a common product experience rather than commissioning Metaphi to redesign the software around their specific operating model. Where substantially different workflows or integrations are required, Metaphi’s Inventory & Distribution Ready-to-Configure Solution or Custom Business Applications offering may be a better fit.

offerings.title: Better Inventory Visibility
offerings.description: give teams a clearer view of inventory information from one system.

offerings.title: More Structured Stock Operations
offerings.description: replace informal or spreadsheet-led stock processes with defined digital workflows.

offerings.title: Easier Day-to-Day Control
offerings.description: provide teams with a consistent operational system rather than maintaining multiple records.

offerings.title: Lower Implementation Complexity
offerings.description: adopt a SaaS product where standardised inventory management is sufficient.

saasProducts.whoItIsForText: Stockiphi should primarily be positioned toward small and growing businesses that need inventory control without the scope or cost structure of a custom enterprise-software implementation. Detailed ICP, vertical targeting and qualification criteria should be frozen separately in the Stockiphi GTM exercise.
saasProducts.notRightFitHeading: When Stockiphi May Not Be the Right Fit
saasProducts.notRightFitText: If an organisation requires complex manufacturing, specialised warehouse logic, extensive system integration, unusual inventory rules or highly customised workflows, a SaaS product may create too many compromises. In those situations, direct the visitor to Inventory & Distribution Management Solution or Custom Business Applications.

faqs.question: Is Stockiphi custom software?
faqs.answer: No. Stockiphi is a standardised SaaS product.

faqs.question: Can Metaphi customise Stockiphi extensively?
faqs.answer: If substantial configuration or custom engineering is required, a Ready-to-Configure or Custom Solution may be more appropriate.

faqs.question: Is Stockiphi suitable for manufacturing?
faqs.answer: It may suit relatively straightforward inventory requirements, but manufacturers with production, procurement, quality and specialised workflows should evaluate Manufacturing Operations or Inventory & Distribution solutions instead.

faqs.question: Can Stockiphi integrate with other systems?
faqs.answer: Publish only verified, currently supported integrations.

faqs.question: How is Stockiphi priced?
faqs.answer: Add pricing only after the commercial model is finalised.

saasHub.heroHeading: Purpose-Built SaaS for Everyday Business Operations
saasHub.heroSubtext: Metaphi develops focused SaaS products for business needs where organisations can benefit from standardised software without commissioning a custom implementation.
saasHub.whySaasSubtext: Not every business requirement needs custom software. When the underlying problem is common across many businesses and does not require significant process engineering, a standardised SaaS product can provide a faster and simpler path to adoption. Metaphi’s SaaS portfolio is designed around that principle.
